free_tier.stated: No free tier. The IPv6-only plan is EUR 1.00 a month or EUR 11.99 a year on the Amsterdam listing, and EUR 11.99 a year only on the Frankfurt and Toronto listings: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk, 1 Gbit/s fair-share, no IPv4 (the Amsterdam listing names an IPv4 add-on), one IPv6 address up to a /52. Stock is a dated observation of the order page, not a property of the plan: on 2026-10-24 Frankfurt carried 'Add to Cart' while Amsterdam and Toronto carried 'Out of Stock'; on 2026-10-30 all three listings carried 'Out of Stock'.

retention.stated: The terms read on 2026-10-30 give a 5-day grace period after the invoice due date ('During this grace period, service will remain in a running state'), suspension after it, and deletion on the 10th day: 'Services will be deleted on the 10th day after the invoice due date if no payment has been made.'

egress.terms: 1 TB a month per the pricing page line 'Traffic 1 TB'; the port is 1 Gbit/s fair-share. No overage price is published and nothing states what happens past 1 TB.

interface_detail: Full root on a KVM guest, with a Proxmox web panel and VNC console, standard Linux distributions or a custom ISO, and weekly backups stated as included. Provisioning is manual: 'All VPSes are provisioned manually within a few hours. We do not use any automated provisioning system.'
tooling: any SSH client; Proxmox panel and VNC; no API documented. A free BGP session with AS11967 is offered, which is unusual at this price and makes it a candidate for a routed-prefix experiment rather than only a tunnel endpoint.
chaining: EUR 11.99 a year for 1 GB and 10 GB with up to a /52 of IPv6 plus a free BGP session, which suits a routed-prefix experiment rather than only a tunnel endpoint. The break is availability: an order needs a listing in stock, and on 2026-10-30 all three listings read 'Out of Stock' (on 2026-10-24 Frankfurt read 'Add to Cart'); provisioning is manual.

limits.value: no IPv4 at all; 'IPv4: none (available as add-on)'. Access is over IPv6, or over an IPv4 address bought separately.
1 TB a month of traffic on a 1 Gbit/s fair-share port
manual provisioning: 'All VPSes are provisioned manually within a few hours', so a purchase is not instant

binding_note: No IPv4 address is included, so a client without IPv6 connectivity must buy the IPv4 add-on; the 1 TB allowance is the second constraint and the price is not one.

identity_cost.detail: no card at registration. The order flow's own signup step at my.hop179.net/order/signup/index/v6-vps collects Contact Information (First Name, Last Name, Company/Org., Title, Address 1, Address 2, City, State, Zip, Country, Phone, Email), a Tax ID/VATIN field, a 'VM Panel Password', then Authentication (username, password, confirm, optional recovery email). The only required identifiers beyond email are a name and a postal address; no card number, no ID document and no phone verification step is on the form, and no card hold or authorisation amount is stated. Payment rails: 'Payments are accepted via PayPal, Credit Card, and Bank Transfer.'

reliability_note: No outage notice appears on the vendor pages read on 2026-10-30. The terms state weekly backups with 'a maximum of 2 (two) copies' kept; no SLA is published.
confidence_note: the EUR 1.00 monthly and EUR 11.99 annual figures, the shape, the /52 IPv6 and the per-location stock buttons are read on 2026-10-30 from the vendor's own order page, whose pricing select carries the term options as markup. The signup fields are read from the vendor's own signup page. The payment rails, the grace period and the deletion day are quoted from the vendor's terms page.

extras.term: as read on 2026-10-30: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or 1 year on the Amsterdam listing; 1 year only on the Frankfurt and Toronto listings
extras.price_arithmetic: Annual: EUR 11.99 a year / 12 = EUR 0.9992 a month, paid in one go; 0.9992 / 0.892784 = USD 1.1192, rounded to USD 1.119. Monthly alternative where offered: EUR 1.00 / 0.892784 = USD 1.1201. Rate: 1 USD = EUR 0.892784 (open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, time_last_update_utc Sat, 24 Oct 2026 00:02:31 +0000). A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so 24/7 and 10 h/day are the same. Out of pocket for the first year: 11.99 / 0.892784 = USD 13.43.
